mechanism: Ropinirole can cause orthostatic hypotension and dizziness, which may be additive with irbesartan's antihypertensive effects, increasing risk of symptomatic hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure and orthostatic vital signs closely; counsel patient on fall precautions and gradual position changes; adjust ropinirole or irbesartan dosing if clinically significant hypotension develops.
